description: [WRITE] Create a Nextdoor Conversion API SERVER tag from the Stape template (stape-io/nextdoor-tag), imported automatically. Needs pixelId (public) plus clientId and accessToken from Nextdoor Ads. Omit `event` to inherit; conversion/lead/purchase/sign_up/custom_conversion_1..10 or a GA4 name are standard. eventId is the dedup row. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

accessToken.description: Nextdoor access token, usually a {{variable}} so it is not stored in plain text on the tag.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

customData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "Nextdoor CAPI Tag".

serverData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

userData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

name: create_nextdoor_capi_server_tag
